description: In a world full of approximations, we live to make these approximations closer to exact. We have members who are multi-talented and have web-development experiences. Our project is centered in Forecasting the future events by analyzing the past. "Learn from your mistakes" and "History repeats itself" are our slagons. Yeah, Linearization-by finding cases happened in different timelines–or in our case by analyzing different problems and their causes in our atmosphere, we can predict the future!
summary: Almost everyone breathes unsafe air, yet few act on a problem they cannot see. ALTAIR Flight makes invisible pollution visible through a desktop game where quests adapt to real-world drone and agricultural data. While engaging youth in solving ecological crises, our live public map helps Uzbek farmers manage harsh environments.
details:
Imagine waking up tomorrow to find the air filled with toxic gases, and realizing no one around you notices. According to the World Health Organization, almost everyone on Earth breathes air that exceeds its recommended pollution limits. Yet people cannot act on a problem they cannot see. Young people spend hours playing video games, which are excellent at holding attention and explaining how complex systems work. However, most are set in imaginary worlds and teach little about today's real problems. That is where ALTAIR shines through.

ALTAIR flight is a desktop game in which players complete quests based on real environmental challenges, such as air pollution and the condition of farmland, and explore how they affect people, crops, and ecosystems. We collaborate with agricultural organizations that provide up-to-date information on specific farming areas, and we will use our own modified drones to measure air pollution in targeted locations. As conditions change, the quests change with them.

Our project is specifially unique that considers both the attitude of youngsters, who are the future of each country, and the organizations that are already contributing. We are the amplifiers that combines both to output better results. The data collected by the organizations help us keep pur websites and game data updated. 

We have also built a map of Uzbekistan that, after launch, we will keep updated and make publicly available online. Farmers in suburban and rural areas can use it to monitor conditions around their land and better manage harsh environments. Because the data is real, the lessons stay relevant; because it is a game, they stay engaging. In our opening scenario, the greatest danger was that only a few people knew. ALTAIR aims to change that by helping a new generation understand our planet's problems, while giving farmers the information they need to prevent future ones.
